question: 张三的入职日期是什么时候
sql: SELECT hire_date FROM employee WHERE name = '张三'
note: 最简单的单表条件查询

question: 销售部2026年6月的收入是多少
sql: SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS total_revenue FROM revenue r INNER JOIN department d ON r.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name = '销售部' AND r.month = '2026-06'
note: 通过部门名关联查收入，需JOIN department

question: 研发部绩效最高的员工是谁
sql: SELECT e.name, p.score FROM performance p INNER JOIN employee e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name = '研发部' ORDER BY p.score DESC LIMIT 1
note: 三表关联 + 排序取最高

question: 各部门的平均绩效得分
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(p.score) AS avg_score FROM performance p INNER JOIN employee e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC
note: 按部门分组求平均

question: 销售部本月迟到率是多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'late' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS late_rate FROM attendance a INNER JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name = '销售部' AND a.work_date LIKE '2026-09%'
note: 迟到率 = 迟到次数/总考勤次数，用 CASE WHEN 条件计数

question: 各部门利润率是多少
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, (SUM(r.amount) - SUM(c.amount)) * 100.0 / SUM(r.amount) AS profit_rate FROM revenue r INNER JOIN cost c ON r.month = c.month AND r.dept_id = c.dept_id INNER JOIN department d ON r.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name
note: 利润率 = (收入-成本)/收入*100，revenue和cost通过month+dept_id关联

question: 本月有多少员工有迟到记录
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.emp_id) AS late_employee_count FROM attendance a WHERE a.status = 'late' AND a.work_date LIKE '2026-09%'
note: 用 COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) 去重统计人数

question: 哪些员工的绩效高于部门平均水平
sql: SELECT e.name, p.score, d.dept_name FROM performance p INNER JOIN employee e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE p.score > (SELECT AVG(p2.score) FROM performance p2 INNER JOIN employee e2 ON p2.emp_id = e2.emp_id WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id AND p2.month = p.month)
note: 用关联子查询计算同部门同月平均绩效作比较

question: 今年各部门的总收入
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, SUM(r.amount) AS total_revenue FROM revenue r INNER JOIN department d ON r.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE r.month LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY d.dept_name
note: 今年用 LIKE '2026-%' 匹配所有月份

question: 迟到次数最多的3个员工
sql: SELECT e.name, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM attendance a INNER JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE a.status = 'late' GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY late_count DESC LIMIT 3
note: 按员工分组统计迟到次数，排序取前3

question: 张三负责了哪些客户
sql: SELECT c.cust_name, c.level, c.industry FROM customer c INNER JOIN employee e ON c.owner_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.name = '张三'
note: 通过 owner_emp_id 关联员工和客户

question: 进行中的项目总预算是多少
sql: SELECT SUM(budget) AS total_budget FROM project WHERE status = 'active'
note: 单表聚合 + 状态条件

question: 张三调过几次薪
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS adjust_count FROM salary_history WHERE emp_id = (SELECT emp_id FROM employee WHERE name = '张三')
note: 通过子查询获取emp_id，统计调薪次数

question: 平均调薪幅度是多少
sql: SELECT AVG((new_salary - old_salary) / old_salary * 100) AS avg_rate FROM salary_history
note: 计算调薪幅度百分比的平均值

question: 2023年有多少人晋升
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS promo_count FROM promotion WHERE promo_date LIKE '2023-%'
note: 用 LIKE 匹配年份前缀统计晋升人数

question: 各部门会议数量排名
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(*) AS meeting_count FROM meeting m INNER JOIN department d ON m.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY meeting_count DESC
note: 按部门分组统计会议数量并排序

question: 各事业部有多少员工
sql: SELECT b.bu_name, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee e INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id INNER JOIN business_unit b ON d.bu_id = b.bu_id GROUP BY b.bu_name
note: employee→department→business_unit 三表关联统计

question: 各部门各成本科目的总成本
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, c.item, SUM(c.amount) AS total_cost FROM cost c INNER JOIN department d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name, c.item
note: 按部门和科目双维度分组

question: 研发部本月出勤率
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'normal' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS attend_rate FROM attendance a INNER JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id INNER JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name = '研发部' AND a.work_date LIKE '2026-09%'
note: 出勤率 = 正常出勤次数/总考勤次数

question: 各行业有多少客户
sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM customer GROUP BY industry ORDER BY cust_count DESC
note: 按行业分组统计客户数量
